title: On variable annuities with surrender charges
abstract: arXiv:2405.02115v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper we provide a theoretical analysis of Variable Annuities (VAs) with a focus on the holder's right to an early termination of the contract. Motivated by risk-management considerations, and in line with existing literature, we assume that the surrender option is optimally exercised from a purely financial perspective (i.e., we consider the worst-case scenario for the insurer). In this context, we rigorously derive the pricing formula for the VA and characterise the optimal surrender time. We also illustrate our theoretical results with extensive numerical experiments.   The pricing problem is formulated as an optimal stopping problem with a time-dependent payoff which is discontinuous at the maturity of the contract and non-smooth. translated_title: 关于带退保费用的可变年金研究
translated_abstract: 本文对可变年金（VAs）进行了理论分析，重点关注持有人提前终止合同的权利。基于风险管理考虑，并与现有文献一致，我们假设退保期权从纯财务角度被最优执行（即考虑保险公司的极端不利情况）。在此背景下，我们严格推导了VA的定价公式，并刻画了最优退保时间。我们还通过大量数值实验展示了理论结果。定价问题被表述为一个最优停止问题，其收益依赖于时间，在合同到期时具有不连续性和非光滑性。这种结构导致非单调的最优停止边界，但我们证明该边界在扩散意义上对于停止集是连续且正则的。缺乏单调性...
tldr: 本文严格推导了带退保费用的可变年金定价公式，并证明了最优退保边界尽管非单调但连续正则，为保险公司风险管理提供了理论支撑。
en_tdlr: This paper rigorously derives the pricing formula for variable annuities with surrender charges and proves that the optimal surrender boundary, though non-monotonic, is continuous and regular, offering theoretical support for insurer risk management.
